rows.reasoning: Heaton co-authored HJR 3 (2014) and voted Yea on its third reading in the Indiana House, a single-subject constitutional amendment whose whole operative text reads "Section 38. Only a marriage between one (1) man and one (1) woman shall be valid or recognized as a marriage in Indiana." That text itself both denies same-sex marriages any validity or recognition in the state and defines marriage as only between one man and one woman, matching the rung "Make same-sex marriage illegal and define marriage as only between one man and one woman" clause for clause rather than by elimination. It excludes the rungs that allow same-sex marriage, and it does not do what "Recognize civil unions for same-sex couples, but reserve marriage for opposite-sex couples" requires.
